Hero.title: Territorial Intelligence and Geospatial Sovereignty for Public and Private Operations
Hero.description: I design end-to-end geographic infrastructures — from PostGIS to production WebGIS. Municipal technical cadastre, land regularization, territorial monitoring and drone photogrammetry, without expensive commercial licenses.

ValueProp.title: Full Command of the Geospatial Pipeline
ValueProp.description: The rare combination of territorial literacy and robust software engineering. I deliver from the spatial data model to the analytical interface, with an open stack and real cadastre governance.

databases.title: Scalable Spatial Databases
databases.description: PostGIS modeling of parcels, blocks, owners, zoning and administrative processes, with audit trails and Brazil SRID (SIRGAS 2000).

integration.title: Enterprise WebGIS
integration.description: React apps with Mapbox, Leaflet or OpenLayers, wired to GeoServer, REST APIs and real-time management dashboards.

analytics.title: Field, Drone and Analysis
analytics.description: Photogrammetry, GNSS, remote sensing and Python/R automation that turn territory into decisions.

Challenge.title: The License and Fragmented-Data Trap
Challenge.subtitle: Why municipalities and territorial operations pay more and still fail to govern the land?
Challenge.description: Proprietary software locks the cadastre behind per-seat licenses. Spreadsheets, loose shapefiles and off-the-shelf WebGIS do not talk to land regularization or permitting. The result is rework, unaudited data and vendor lock-in.
Challenge.card_commercial_desc: Rising per-seat cost, data scattered across files, no audit trail, weak privacy controls and no link to the administrative process.
Challenge.card_local_desc: Your own stack: PostGIS + GeoServer + WebGIS. Predictable cost, sovereign data, business rules of the municipality or operation — and full control of the cadastre.

Engine.title: SIGTER: the engine of your cadastre
Engine.description: SIGTER is not a shelf product — it is the architectural foundation I deploy in your operation. Managers see parcels, blocks, land regularization and zoning in real time, with spatial audit and no per-seat license.

Pillars.title: Three Pillars of Territorial Impact
Pillars.subtitle: The focus is cadastral governance, data sovereignty and operational return.
Pillars.routing_desc: Municipal technical cadastre and social/specific land regularization: settlement and parcel geometry, documents, titling and an audit trail aligned with the administrative process.
Pillars.bi_desc: Dashboards that confront planned territory with what was executed. Query, edit, official sketches and change history — with privacy and traceability.
Pillars.topology_desc: Drones, GNSS and photogrammetry integrated into the spatial database. From field survey to official map, without losing topology or metadata.

CustomEngineering.title: Custom Geospatial Engineering
CustomEngineering.subtitle: High-impact applications designed and deployed end to end.
CustomEngineering.observation_desc: APIs and WebGIS with Google Earth Engine, environmental and coastal monitoring, vegetation, mining and automated time-series analysis.
CustomEngineering.logistics_desc: Databases and applications for city halls and secretariats: technical cadastre, zoning, social-interest areas and territorial logistics.
CustomEngineering.infrastructure_desc: GeoServer tuning, PostGIS modeling, Docker, large-scale workspaces and performance plugins for fast map rendering.

Portfolio.title: Delivery Portfolio
Portfolio.subtitle: Real projects in WebGIS, spatial databases, photogrammetry and territorial management.
